facts.declaredMachine: The Linux runner the measurements below ran on. SPEC.md section 19 names a declared Linux machine with 16 GiB memory; this runner exposes the memory recorded here, which is below that class, so the comparison against the targets carries that deviation openly.
facts.buildMode: CPython interpreter resolved by `uv sync --locked` from the committed uv.lock; compiled pydantic-core and pyarrow extensions; assertions off; the Pi Durable storage worker is a fresh Node helper process per service open; no debug or instrumented builds anywhere in the loop

method: Closed-loop threads call process_frame on one service; lock timing includes only outermost acquisitions. No network or native rendering.
